summary: The heaviest charge filed in the Fairbanks area on Friday was burglary in the first degree in a dwelling, a Class B felony recorded as domestic violence related, against Paidan Brentley Drayton on an offense dated Oct. 22. Fairbanks police records released during the day added the arrest behind a five-count domestic violence assault case and an arrest for violating a domestic violence protective order, and court files were opened behind Thursday's felony vehicle-theft arrest and the extraditable warrant arrest of a Texas woman. Ten Fairbanks criminal cases were entered on Oct. 22 and Oct. 23, after the close of the Oct. 15 to Oct. 21 weekly filings report whose counts appear below, so those counts do not include them.

entries.title: Burglary charge: Paidan Brentley Drayton
body: Paidan Brentley Drayton was charged with burglary in the first degree in a dwelling, a Class B felony, together with criminal trespass in the first degree in a dwelling, a Class A misdemeanor, and violating conditions of release for a misdemeanor, a Class B misdemeanor. The court file records the burglary and trespass counts as domestic violence related.
Fairbanks, Oct. 22. The case was filed Oct. 23 and no arresting agency is named on the file.
Case 4FA-26-02148CR; arraignment held Oct. 23, preliminary hearing Nov. 2.

entries.title: Assault arrest: Debrah Sarah Erma Holmberg
body: Debrah Sarah Erma Holmberg, 31, was arrested on charges of assault in the fourth degree and assault when a child is present. The court file carries five counts — one of assault in the fourth degree and four of assault when a child is present — each a Class A misdemeanor and each recorded as domestic violence related.
700 block of Munna Court, Fairbanks, Oct. 22 at 5:16 a.m.; Fairbanks Police.
Case 4FA-26-02138CR; arraignment held Oct. 22, pre-trial conference Dec. 10.

entries.title: Vehicle theft arrest: Jesse Mae May
body: Jesse Mae May, 32, was arrested on a charge of vehicle theft in the first degree, a Class C felony on the court file.
5100 block of Airport Industrial Road at Mail Trail, Fairbanks, Oct. 22 at 4:11 p.m.; Fairbanks Police. The court file records the offense as dated Oct. 20.
Case 4FA-26-02146CR; arraignment held Oct. 23, preliminary hearing Nov. 2.

entries.title: Warrant arrest: Makalyn Fulton
body: Makalyn Fulton, 27, of Texas, was arrested in Fairbanks on an extraditable warrant and charged under the Alaska statute for arrest prior to requisition, recorded as fugitive from justice. No degree of offense is recorded, so no charge class is stated.
Fairbanks, Oct. 22 at about 5:24 p.m.; Alaska State Troopers. She was taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center to await extradition.
Case 4FA-26-02145CR; arraignment Oct. 24, fugitive-from-justice hearing Nov. 20.
